sections.zh:
[Root.GetAdj]社会有句谚语“知足常乐。”只要学会感恩，就会发现处处皆是生命的馈赠。在这样的水中，我们已经繁荣昌盛了很久。

但我们中的老者并没有意识到这种停滞。他们将我们对生存的渴望视为急躁。如果我们不寻求改变，那么变化很可能会杀我们个措手不及。辽阔的宇宙中我们必然不是孤身一人。要想保护家园，有些人必须离开家园。

事实证明，深入深渊是值得的。艰苦卓绝的打捞工作带回了令人惊叹的残骸，触发了洪水般的科技突跃。最终，我们终于准备好了突入大洋以外的世界，去探索、去见证、去学习、去保护。
sections.en:
"Joy to those who possess the wisdom of acceptance." So goes a common proverb in [Root.GetAdj] society. The bounty of life is all around, once one learns to appreciate it. In such waters, long have we prospered.

But our elders do not sense the stagnation. They confuse our survival instincts with impatience. If we do not seek change, change will find us, and we will be unprepared. We cannot be alone in this vast universe. To keep our home, some of us must resolve to leave it.

Our descents into the Abyss have proven worthwhile. Unworldly wreckage, perilously retrieved, precipitated a torrent of technological breakthroughs. At last, we are ready to journey beyond our oceans, to explore, to see, to learn, and to protect.

sections.en:
"Joy to we who possess the wisdom of acceptance." The bounty of life is all around, once one learns to appreciate it. In such waters, long have we prospered.

Alas, stagnation nears. If we do not seek change, change will find us, and we will be unprepared. We cannot be alone in this vast universe. To keep our home, part of us must resolve to leave it.

Our descents into the Abyss have proven worthwhile. Unworldly wreckage, perilously retrieved, precipitated a torrent of technological breakthroughs. At last, we are ready to journey beyond our oceans, to explore, to see, to learn, and to protect.

起始殖民地为海洋世界（pc_ocean），水生特质；农业区不设上限（旗标 uncapped_farming）。
The homeworld is an ocean world (pc_ocean) with the aquatic trait and uncapped farming districts (flag uncapped_farming).

No story windows; generic colony.9850 and hidden aquatics.1001 have branches for this origin.

无。 None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

可选条件见起源卡。 Requirements are on the origin card.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：起源定义、开局设置与全部事件目录中对该起源的引用。 The origin definition, its start setup and every reference to the origin in the events folder.
